verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents webhooks that let your own integration react to verification events, and a blocklist that automatically rejects future verifications using a blocked document. Neither is a product feature for setting up autonomous background automations: webhooks are developer building blocks the user must build on, and the blocklist is an adjacent fraud control. No first-party automation, scheduling, or rule-builder capability appears in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
